# OpenUI

> Framework-native UI components installed as source. No runtime dependencies.

OpenUI writes components directly into your project for React, Svelte, Astro,
and Vue. Components are plain framework code styled with Tailwind CSS v4; the
`openui` CLI handles configuration, installation, and registry validation.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/getting-started): Install OpenUI, initialize a project, and add your first component.
- [Configuration](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/configuration): Every field in openui.json, how discovery works, and how CLI flags interact with the file.
- [CLI](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/cli): Commands, flags, exit codes, and the safety model behind file writes.
- [Registry](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/registry): How the OpenUI registry is laid out, generated, served, and validated.
- [Theming](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/theming): Style OpenUI components with Tailwind CSS v4 utilities, dark mode, and local overrides.
- [Contributing](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/contributing): Repository layout, local workflow, verification, changesets, and known beta limitations.

## Components

- [Components](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components): Nine framework-native components, each rendered natively for React, Svelte, Astro, and Vue.
- [Button](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/button): A framework-native button with six disjoint variants, four sizes, and a full-width option.
- [Input](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/input): A native text input with the shared h-10 field treatment and an invalid state.
- [Textarea](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/textarea): A native multi-line input that shares the Input field treatment.
- [Select](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/select): A native select element with shared field styling and a decorative chevron.
- [Checkbox](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/checkbox): A native checkbox input styled with Tailwind accents and an invalid state.
- [Radio](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/radio): A native radio input. Group inputs by sharing a name and pair them with Label.
- [Label](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/label): A native label with form typography and peer-disabled styling.
- [Field](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/field): Composes a label, control, and hint or error message with for/id and aria-describedby wiring.
- [Theme](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/components/theme): Light, dark, and system theme state with a no-flash init script and a cycling toggle.

## Frameworks

- [React](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/react): Install and use OpenUI components in React, including TypeScript and JavaScript variants.
- [Svelte](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/svelte): Install and use OpenUI components in Svelte 5 projects.
- [Astro](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/astro): Install and use OpenUI components in Astro projects.
- [Vue](https://openuii.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/vue): Install and use OpenUI components in Vue 3 projects.
